description: Lists the 7 datasets behind the statistics page's 4 charts and 3 tables (id, kind, title, topic, section, row count; ids are not consecutive) with the download addresses: the whole page as CSV and JSON, one SVG per chart, the screening-test JSON and the changelog JSON. Pass an id to get that one dataset's rows (3 to 12 per dataset) with values, notes and reference keys, plus the license and citeAs text. Use this for topics beyond prevalence (persistence, maths anxiety, interventions, by-country, sex ratio, comorbidity) or for the exact rows a chart plots; use get_prevalence instead for prevalence figures with sample size, age and filters (chart-1 plots only a subset of those entries). An unknown id returns an error listing the valid ids.

id.description: Dataset id, exact: chart-1, chart-6, chart-8, chart-9, table-2, table-4, table-5. Omit to list every dataset without its rows.
